title: Same Amount, Different Look
objective: Rearranging a group of objects does not change how many there are (conservation of number) — the first appearance of Same Value, Different Form.
studentQuestion: Did the amount change when I moved them?

teaching.setup: 6 counters in a tight cluster; count them together.
teaching.see: We counted 6. Watch what I do next.
teaching.break: Spread the same 6 counters into a long row, in view of the learner.
teaching.build: Ask for a prediction before recounting: how many now?
teaching.transform: Same quantity, different arrangement — this unit's version of TRANSFORM; no symbolic step exists yet.

check.prompt: Recount the spread-out row; it still totals 6.

examples.transfer: A group the learner rearranges themselves, then predicts before recounting.

mastery.evidence: Correctly predicts the count stays the same before recounting, across at least two different rearrangements.
